evidence: empty_void: At seg3:start and seg3:mid the whole middle of the frame is empty dark ground around one thin bar and a tiny grey '0' stub. At seg4:start three thermometers sit at the top over a large empty field.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: At seg2:mid and seg2:end two long labels are drawn at the same spot, so the text above the gauge is illegible. The '36% apart' gap between two thin poles barely shows the 68% share, and the mascot just stands with his hands on his head.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The labels for the two poles are placed at one anchor with no collision check. The machine turns a share-of-people claim into a gap between two poles, which asserts nothing about 68% of residents.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show the 68% share as people: for example, 100 residents filling hot and cool blocks, with 68 landing in the hot ones. Draw one label per group with measured, non-overlapping positions, and give the mascot an action tied to the split, such as being herded or fanning himself in the hot block.
